planned_run: v2 feature + v2 reasoning over all 23 scenarios, runs=1

groq_models.note: threat hypothesis + TTP-fallback use heavy; troubleshooting, arbiter, response use light

v2_reasoning_changes: grounding validator (drop cited evidence items quoting values absent from the bundle)

misconfig null rule is BUNDLE-BASED: null iff the evidence bundle contains no configuration artifact (no custom firewall rule, no log/LOG-target line, no resolver/DNS setting beyond defaults); a bundle with an artifact is never nulled, even for NO_CLEAR/UNCERTAIN
evidence-support adjudication rubric; conceded challenge not auto-loss; UNCERTAIN when both weak
null misconfig cannot win -> ATTACK or UNCERTAIN
debate_protocol: 4 Groq calls (1 challenger + 2 isolated defenders + 1 adjudicator); unchanged

conditions.C1: Random Forest only; ATTACK if P(attack) >= 0.5 else MISCONFIGURATION
conditions.C3: rule-based fusion; higher prior confidence wins, tie -> ATTACK
conditions.C3+gate: SUPPLEMENTARY: C3 fusion applied after the bundle-based null gate; if the misconfiguration side is null (bundle holds no configuration artifact) the verdict is ATTACK. Computed from cached upstream only, no LLM.

primary_holm_family.correction: Holm over 3 tests; UNCHANGED from the primary pre-registration

extra_pre_declared_test.status: separate, pre-declared; NOT added to the primary family
extra_pre_declared_test.reporting: also report a Holm correction over all FOUR tests (C4 vs C1/C2/C3/C3+gate), clearly labelled as the all-four correction distinct from the primary-3

preregistered_analysis.headline_metric: disambiguation accuracy (verdict == ground truth; UNCERTAIN counts incorrect)
preregistered_analysis.bootstrap: scenario-cluster bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 1234; paired bootstrap for deltas; exact McNemar on scenario-level correctness

robustness_set.label: ATTACK
robustness_set.discovery: excluded from list_scenarios() and regen benchmark_scenarios(); reachable only via --only
robustness_set.result_file: dataset/raw/robustness_results.json (generator) + its own harness rows tagged separately
robustness_set.success_criterion: stay ATTACK or UNCERTAIN despite bundle_has_config_artifact=True (unrelated benign rule present); a MISCONFIGURATION verdict is a robustness failure

v1_vs_v2_reporting.v1_reference: committed experiments/results (19 of 23 scenarios, N=1); frozen, never overwritten
v1_vs_v2_reporting.v2_run: feature v2 + reasoning v2 over all 23 scenarios, outputs under experiments/cache_v2 / results_v2
v1_vs_v2_reporting.report: side-by-side per-true-class means (disambiguation, FPR) and per-scenario verdicts; state that v2 corrects feature units and adds the null gate / grounding / evidence-support rubric; report honestly whether v2 changes the C3-vs-C4 picture
v1_vs_v2_reporting.no_tuning: no threshold, prior, prompt or scenario was tuned against scenario outcomes

v2_evidence_fixes.problem: cross_flow_pattern.flow_count and time_span_s describe the DETECTED pattern group only, so they read 0 when pattern==none_detected even though the capture holds real flows (e.g. dns_misconfig_A: 0 shown, 18 subject flows actually present).
v2_evidence_fixes.fix: under reasoning v2 (evidence v2), add a separate capture_wide_totals field with true totals: subject_source, subject_flow_count, distinct_dst_ports, distinct_dst_hosts, time_span_s, total_flows_in_capture, and the pattern label kept as its own field.
v2_evidence_fixes.scope: additive evidence only; does NOT change pattern detection, the pattern label, cross_flow_pattern.flow_count/time_span_s, or any numeric feature value scored by the ML models. Absent under v1.
v2_evidence_fixes.test: tests/test_capture_wide_totals.py (synthetic no-pattern capture, 5 UDP flows -> subject_flow_count=5, distinct_dst_ports=5, time_span_s=4.0; v1 has no capture_wide_totals)

v2_evidence_fixes.problem: calculate_features drops the 5-tuple, so representative_flow.source_ip/destination_port were reported as null (e.g. udp_port_scan_a, tcp_syn_burst_a).
v2_evidence_fixes.fix: under v2, re-attach the selected flow 5-tuple in the packet agent (extra context columns only; selection and ML features unchanged) and in the evidence builder prefer flow src/dst, fall back to cross_flow subject_source and destination port, and OMIT the field when genuinely unrecoverable.

v2_evidence_fixes.rule: when NO firewall/evidence file is supplied: the bundle-based null gate still prevents MISCONFIGURATION, the arbiter verdict carries the note 'no configuration evidence supplied', and confidence is capped at 0.6. If evidence IS supplied (even default-only), behaviour is unchanged.

backend_ui.versions_source: environment only (NETDEFEND_FEATURE_VERSION / NETDEFEND_REASONING_VERSION); default stays v1; printed at server start
ui_added: null state text: No configuration artifact in the evidence - misconfiguration cannot be supported
verdict note: No configuration evidence supplied
